title: Russia fails in bid to reverse ban on its ships using Europe’s docks and locks
lede: Russian authorities challenged restrictive measures imposed by EU ministers against ships approved by the St Petersburg ship-certifying body. The EU's General Court rejected a bid to overturn the ban, but left the door open for future recognition of the authority.

title: The great disaster divide: How the super-rich are profiting from global climate suffering
lede: New research from Oxfam shows the wealthiest 0.1% are making money from the climate crisis their pollution has caused, while buying protection for themselves The post The great disaster divide: How the super-rich are profiting from global climate suffering appeared first on Climate Home News .

title: Afghan pushback survivor fights ‘impossible’ evidence rules in European courts with new UN case against Greecee
lede: The EU's human rights court rejected a case from an Afghan pushback survivor who was just 15 years old when he was turned back to Turkey by the Hellenic coast guard. The impossibility of achieving justice on the systematic practice against migrants of all ages was highlighted by the European court's inadmission, as the young survivor was forced to appeal to the UN's human rights courts instead.

title: Moldova seen as ‘best performer’ on EU-accession reforms, despite onslaught of Russian sabotage
lede: Chișinău's progress took place against a backdrop of growing hybrid attacks from Russia, such as drones entering the country’s airspace, cyberattacks, and Moldovan citizens recruited to perform sabotage.
